iti82:1.1: vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā. vuttamarahatā’ti me sutaṃ:
iti82:2.1: tayo’me bhikkhave devesu devasaddā niccharanti samayā samayaṃ upādāya.
iti82:2.3: yasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye ariyasāvako kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajjāya ceteti. tasmiṃ samaye devesu devasaddo niccharati
iti82:2.5: ayaṃ bhikkhave paṭhamo devesu devasaddo niccharati samayā samayaṃ upādāya.
iti82:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave yasmiṃ samaye ariyasāvako sattannaṃ bodhipakkhiyānaṃ dhammānaṃ bhāvanānuyogamanuyutto viharati, tasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye devesu devasaddo niccharati
iti82:3.3: ayaṃ bhikkhave dutiyo devesu devasaddo niccharati samayā samayaṃ upādāya.
iti82:4.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave yasmiṃ samaye ariyasāvako āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati. tasmiṃ bhikkhave samaye devesu devasaddo niccharati
iti82:4.2: “eso ariyasāvako vijitasaṅgāmo tameva saṅgāmasīsaṃ abhivijiya ajjhāvasatī”ti.
iti82:4.3: ayaṃ bhikkhave tatiyo devesu devasaddo niccharati samayā samayaṃ upādāya.
iti82:4.4: ime kho bhikkhave tayo devesu devasaddā niccharanti samayā samayaṃ upādāyā’ti.
iti82:8.1: ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā. iti me sutanti.
